Check whether fuzzy matches are explained by misspellings

Source: R/acceptable.R
WFO.spelling.check.Rd

A name has one correct spelling, the one in the taxonomic backbone. When WFO.match() finds a name by fuzzy matching, the submitted spelling differs from the correct one. WFO.spelling.check() tells whether the difference is explained by common misspellings that do not change which name was meant (so that the correction made by fuzzy matching can be trusted), or whether the names differ in other ways (so that the match should be checked: it may be a different name).

Usage

WFO.spelling.check(x, spec.name = "spec.name", no.vowels = FALSE)

Arguments

x

Results of WFO.match() or WFO.one().

spec.name

Name of the column with the submitted names.

no.vowels

If TRUE, also treat differences in vowels as misspellings.

Value

A character vector with one value per row of x:

"identical"

the submitted name is spelled as in the backbone;

"spelling corrected"

the names differ only by the misspellings listed above;

"other difference"

the names differ in other ways: check the match;

NA

no name was matched.

Details

The submitted name is compared with the matched name; for synonyms replaced by their accepted names, with the synonym that was matched (Old.name). Both are first put in a form where these common misspellings disappear (examples from the WFO):

  • wrong gender of the epithet: endings -um and -us become -a, and -is becomes -e (Decarydendron ranomafanensis for Decarydendron ranomafanense);

  • a missing or extra hyphen (the first one) or hybrid sign (Sorbus avonensis for Sorbus × avonensis);

  • i written as j, or ii as i (Syzygium naiadum for Syzygium najadum);

  • single and double letters confused (tt, ll, rr, mm, nn, ff, hh, dd; Ficus scott-elliottii for Ficus scott-elliotii), and dt for d (Stadtmannia for Stadmania);

  • with no.vowels = TRUE, any vowel (including y).

See also

WFO.match()

Examples

x <- data.frame(
  spec.name = c(
    "Ficus scott-elliotii", "Ficus scott-elliottii",
    "Coffea arabicus", "Acacia nilotica", "Xx yy"
  ),
  scientificName = c(
    "Ficus scott-elliotii", "Ficus scott-elliotii",
    "Coffea arabica", "Acacia senegal", NA
  ),
  New.accepted = FALSE, Old.name = ""
)
WFO.spelling.check(x)
#> [1] "identical"          "spelling corrected" "spelling corrected"
#> [4] "other difference"   NA                  

data(WFO.example2026)
m <- WFO.match(c("Faidherbia albida", "Faidherbia albidum", "Pygeum afric"),
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026, verbose = FALSE
)
#> Checking for fuzzy matches for 2 records
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
cbind(m[, c("spec.name", "Fuzzy", "Old.name", "scientificName")],
  spelling = WFO.spelling.check(m)
)
#>            spec.name Fuzzy         Old.name    scientificName
#> 1  Faidherbia albida FALSE                  Faidherbia albida
#> 2 Faidherbia albidum  TRUE                  Faidherbia albida
#> 3       Pygeum afric  TRUE Pygeum africanum   Prunus africana
#>             spelling
#> 1          identical
#> 2 spelling corrected
#> 3   other difference
